notes.title: Lennod Jump Game Update 1
notes.notes:
The game has been updated to version 2.11.3.

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Free-Play Stage Select mode added, accessible via title screen
[*] All known bugs were fixed & then re-implemented as intentional features
[/list]

Please enjoy your continued jumping with Lennod.

Please also enjoy the official update trailer created by our graphics lead.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XTPDKa7mX5E
